about.lead: I'm Leonardo Parisi, a frontend developer from Italy. I build dynamic, engaging interfaces with the latest of the web — and I care about the last 10% as much as the first 90%.
about.secondary: Freelance client work, an internship in IT security, and a steady habit of rebuilding things until they feel right. Motion isn't decoration here — it's how the interface explains itself.
